messages:
marina: Quick Q about embeddings API: if callers send non-string input (ints, objects) do we coerce to a JSON string or return 400? also what's the per-request item limit and per-item truncation rule? planning a migration and want to know BC risks.
kevin: Current behavior: server expects `input: string | string[]`. Historically some older SDKs coerced non-strings client-side, but the HTTP API is strict and returns 400 for non-string items by default. There is an internal feature-flag `coerce-emb-input` that will try to stringify unknown types, but it's opt-in per-tenant.
marina: I couldn't find that flag in public docs — is it safe to rely on for a migration?
kevin: It's not public. We can enable it for a tenant for short-term migrations, but we shouldn't depend on it long-term. Better to update callers to send strings. Example server request shape we expect: `POST /v1/embeddings {"model":"foo","input":["a","b"]}`
kevin: curl example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["hello world",""]}'
```
sara: Batch limits: hard limit is 512 items per request. There's also a payload size cap (~4MB) to protect against huge single requests. Per-item truncation uses the model tokenizer and the model max_context (eg 8192 tokens). Runtime default truncation policy is `right` (we keep the last tokens). That behavior is set in the runtime config as `embedding_truncation=right`.
marina: we rely on prefix context, so truncating from the left (dropping the end) would be preferable for us. any per-call override?
jon: PR #4321 adds two args to the embeddings endpoint: `truncation` ("left" | "right" | "none") and `preserve_empty` (boolean). It's merged to canary and will roll out next week. Default stays `right` for BC; `preserve_empty=true` keeps returning a zero-vector for empty strings. If you set `preserve_empty=false` the server will return 400 for empty items.
kevin: Output shape note: response returns `{data:[{embedding:[float,...],index:0},...],model:"rwd-embed-1",usage:{...}}`. embedding length == model.dim (check `GET /v1/models/{id}` for exact dim). When `preserve_empty=true` an empty string maps to an all-zero vector of length model.dim. When it's false you'll get an error for empty inputs.
marina: helpful. any change to SDKs we should expect? iOS client is strict-typed and might send ints for small numbers.
sara: SDK releases: web + python clients will add explicit type validation and the new `truncation` parameter tomorrow. iOS PR is queued — we'll need an extra patch to coerce to strings or reject at call site.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2025-06-07 03:00 UTC for eng-ml canary.
marina: planning to enable `coerce-emb-input` for our staging tenant while we update callers, and we'll test with `preserve_empty=false` to see failures surface. ping me if that causes trouble.
kevin: ping when you run tests — can help with logs and confirm that model.dim matches expectations.
marina: thanks all :thumbsup:
